label: Barnard's Star
position_rule: follows Gaia DR3 4472832130942575872 (proper motion, straight line)
data_credit: NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA), SPHEREx, ESA Gaia DR3
reason: The star's saturated (no-value) core reaches 5.2 px from its centre in at least one exposure. Measuring the light around it would need a ring starting at 6 px, and only rings starting at most 3 px out were checked to follow a star's brightness (RW Aur, 3-6 px: about 10%). So no light curve is given.

comparison.rule: Gaia DR3 stars with G <= 17, no Gaia star less than 3 mag fainter within 4 px, measured like the target (radius 2 px, sky 5-8 px) with the same comparison rule
